item.title: Heritage Village Skilled Nursing Facility in the Town of Gerry to close
item.description: Another nursing home is closing in Western New York, marking the latest facility to shut down amid challenges facing the long-term care industry.

item.title: Residents at Buffalo Municipal Housing Authority properties endure stretch without heat during extreme cold
item.description: Residents at Buffalo Municipal Housing Authority properties have been left without power and heat during a stretch of cold weather, concerns about conditions in the city's public housing system.

item.title: ‘These were crimes against children’: Clergy sex abuse survivors in Buffalo Diocese share their stories
item.description: More than five years after the first Child Victims Act lawsuit was filed, clergy sex abuse survivors of the Buffalo Diocese are finally having their voices heard in federal court.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters gather outside Immigration and Customs Enforcement office in Buffalo
item.description: Solidarity was the message as demonstrators protested U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement here in Buffalo and across the country on Wednesday.
